name: erp
description: Payroll ERP System with Mobile PWA and Employee Portal

scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && node scripts/copy-dist.js
scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run build && npx firebase deploy --only hosting --non-interactive
scripts.deploy:vercel: node scripts/sync-server.js && git add . && git commit -m "Update ERP" && git push origin main
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:firebase && npm run deploy:vercel
